_note: svelte2tsx writes an {#each} pattern up to the start of its type annotation (`getEnd` in htmlxtojsx_v2/utils/node-utils.ts), so `item: string` becomes `for (let item of …)`: a for-of binding cannot carry an annotation, and the annotation is not checked at all (`item: number` over strings is accepted). The same rule decides whether the iterable and the item share a name, looking through `!` / `as` / `satisfies`, so `{#each maybe! as maybe}` goes through the `$$_each` temp. Copying the annotation gave TS2483 ('The left-hand side of a for...of statement cannot use a type annotation'), and `maybe!` against `maybe` read the binding in its own initializer.
